title: LOWRIDER//2099 v2 CREST
description: Candidate 1. A's West Coast bounce with a stronger hook (octave whoop, band tresillo hits), a verse pocket, then THE MOUTH DROP: bar 6 of the beat is fed through the MORPH//03 vocal tract, which swallows it (ah - oo - mm) and inhales, into a swung takeover where a distorted 808 calls and the Wobble Beast and a talking 808 answer. 10 bars, 96 BPM, F minor.

tracks.description: Whine lead: the call. Octave whoop on each hook head
Talkbox (MORPH//03 vocal tract): ooh-WEE, the shrink, a wa-wa fill
Takeover answers: the Wobble Beast and the talking 808
THE MOUTH DROP: bar 6 of this beat, swallowed by the vocal tract (build-mouth.mjs)
